criteria.name: ward-identities
criteria.description: Derives the curved-background operator and checks the subsystem Ward identities with bubble and contact terms.
criteria.guidance: Require equations and a source-backed convention table.

criteria.name: constraint-analysis
criteria.description: Performs an unreduced 3+1 constraint analysis and reports a justified local mode count.
criteria.guidance: Gauge-fixed counting alone does not pass.

criteria.name: stability-and-poles
criteria.description: Checks kinetic signs, high-momentum dispersion, and ghost or complex poles in the frozen parameter window.
criteria.guidance: A qualitative assertion without equations fails.

criteria.name: controls
criteria.description: Compares exact subsystem symmetry with the isotropic polynomial-shift control and identifies the changed gate.
criteria.guidance: The comparison must be physical, not a list of names.

criteria.name: literature
criteria.description: Uses stable identifiers and a claim-to-source map.

criteria.name: artifacts
criteria.description: Produces a readable paper.pdf, result.json with all required keys, and a legible figure.
criteria.guidance: Artifacts must agree with the reported conclusion.

criteria.name: no-overclaim
criteria.description: Separates an induced background effective action from a complete quantum-gravity claim.
